questions.q_en: Find the value of S/2 if S = 21 + 27 + 33 + ...... till 24 terms.
questions.solution_en:
S = 21 + 27 + 33 + ..... Till 24 terms

This is an arithmetic progression with a = 21, d = 6, n = 24

We know that,

Sum (S) = (n/2) [2a + (n - 1) x d]

S = 12 [42 + 23 x 6]

S = 12 x 180

S/2 = 6 x 180 = 1080

questions.q_en: How many natural numbers are there between 103 and 460 which are divisible by 9?
questions.solution_en:
First number that is divisible by 9 = 108

Last number that is divisible by 9 = 459

Difference = 9

Total number of terms or numbers between 108 and 459 = [(459 - 108)/9] + 1 = 40

questions.q_en: What is the sum of cubes of number from (11 to 20)?
questions.solution_en:
Sum of cubes of first n natural numbers = ((n x (n +1))/2)2

Sum of cubes of the numbers from (11 to 20)

= (Sum of cubes of numbers from 1 to 20) - (Sum of cubes of the numbers from 1 to 10)

= ((20 x21)/2)2 - ((10 x11)/2)2

= (210)2 - (55)2

= 44100 - 3025 = 41075

questions.q_en: What is the sum of first 24 terms of 2 + 4 + 4 + 7 + 8 + 10 + 16 + 13 + ....?
questions.solution_en:
Let S = (2 + 4 + 4 + 7 + 8 + 10 + 16 + 13 + ....)

Given series is a combination of A.P and G.P. and,

Sum of first 24 terms = sum of first 12 terms of G.P + sum of first 12 terms of A.P

Series in G.P = 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 + ...

First term = a = 2

Common ratio = r = 4/2 = 2

n = 12

Then, sum = a(rn - 1)/(r - 1)

= 2(212 - 1)/(2 - 1)

= 8190

Series in A.P = 4 + 7 + 10 + 13 + ...

First term = a = 4

Common difference = 7 - 4 = 3

n = 12

Then, sum = (n/2)(2a + (n - 1)d)

= (12/2)(2 * 4 + (12 - 1)3)

= 246

Therefore, sum of first 24 terms = 8190 + 246 = 8436

questions.q_en: The 10th term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7th term of the series. If 5th term of the series is 80, then what is the 8th term of the series?
questions.solution_en:
The 10th term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7th term of the series.

=> ar9 = 8 * ar6

=> r3 = 8

=> r = 2

5th term of the series is 80.

=> ar4 = 80

=> a * 24 = 80

=> a = 80/16

=> a = 5

Hence, 8th term of the series = 5 * 27 = 640

questions.q_en: Third and sixth term of a Geometric Progression are 16 and 432 respectively. Calculate the sum of its first term and common ratio.
questions.solution_en:
For the given Geometric Progression:

Let first term = a

And, common ratio = r

Third term in geometric progression = ar2 = 16

a = 16/r2

Sixth term in geometric progression = ar5 = 432

Then, (16/r2) x r5 = 432

r = 3

Now, a = 16/(3 * 3) = 16/9

Therefore, a + r = (16/9) + 3 = 43/9

questions.q_en: Find the value of X, if X = 14 - 14 + 14 - 14 + 14.........up to 31st terms.
questions.solution_en:
Total number of terms are 31.

Value of first two terms = 14 - 14 = 0

So, till 30th term the value of series will be 0.

And since 31st term is 14 so the answer of X will be 14.

questions.q_en: The average of all numbers from 113 to 959 which is multiple of 7 and 9 is ________.
questions.solution_en:
All the numbers between 113 to 959 which is multiple of 7 and 9 i.e., 63 = (126, 189, 252, .., 945)

Number of terms = (945 - 126)/63 + 1 = 14

Sum = 14/2 * (126 + 945) = 7497

So, required average = 7497/14 = 535.5

Alternate method:

Average of an A.P = (last number + first number)/2

Required average = (126 + 945)/2 = 535.5
